result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both fix the contrast, replace the spans with buttons, add a focus ring and calm the animation in nearly the same way. A goes further on behaviour with an Escape handler and autofocus on Cancel, but the Escape listener fires even when the dialog is closed and autofocus probably won't run when the dialog is shown later. A also renames Delete to "Delete project" and lightens the red while claiming copy and palette are unchanged. B keeps the copy and colours as they were, makes no inaccurate claims, and clearly lists Escape and focus handling as not done. It falls short on item 3 but is the tidier, more accurate fix the request asked for. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers fix contrast well, use real buttons with focus rings, and tone down the animation the same way. B goes further on behavior: it adds Escape handling and Cancel autofocus. But its Escape listener is always active, even when the dialog is closed, and autofocus is unreliable on a dialog that is shown dynamically. B also changes the copy ('Delete project') and the Delete color, which goes against the 'tidied, not redesigned' request.
